query:
WITH RECURSIVE up(id, depth) AS (
               SELECT $1::uuid, 0
               UNION ALL
               SELECT r.to_doc, up.depth + 1 FROM up
               JOIN relations r ON r.from_doc = up.id AND r.tenant_id = $2
                 AND r.copy = 'published' AND r.field_path = 'folder'
               WHERE up.depth <= $3
           )
           SELECT id AS "id!" FROM up ORDER BY depth
